title: Identification and Structural Characterization of Twisted Atomically Thin Bilayer Materials by Deep Learning
summary: The model provided twist-angle estimates for CVD-grown bilayer MoS2 samples, including irregular flakes, with sample measurements checked against second-harmonic-generation spectroscopy; Raman spectra also varied with measured twist angle. Predicted angles for actual grown samples were compared with SHG measurements, and Raman spectra were examined across angles. Validation is limited to the reported sample set and does not demonstrate new phases or downstream device performance.
ai_technology: A supervised CNN segments optical micrographs to classify layer thickness; a ResNet trained on synthetic triangular-flake images predicts twist angles from images of CVD-grown bilayers.
